headline: Lullaby "mistakes" that are actually fine
items: Singing off-key, because they don't know and they don't care
Forgetting the words halfway and humming the rest
Singing the same song for the 400th night in a row
Making up a whole verse about their socks at 3am

cta.eyebrow: What matters is that it's theirs.
cta.ask: Make their song free in minutes
